normalization_refs.definition: 0.5 * [clip((peak_Hs - thr_Hs_local - Q05_E_Hs) / (Q95_E_Hs - Q05_E_Hs), 0, 1) + clip((peak_SSH - thr_SSH_local - Q05_E_SSH) / (Q95_E_SSH - Q05_E_SSH), 0, 1)], where E denotes the excess over the local q90 detection threshold and the percentiles are pooled over all compound events of all grid points
normalization_refs.population: all compound-event excesses pooled over the native grid
normalization_refs.abspeak_definition: Superseded audit metric: the same average applied to the absolute peaks rescaled by the domain-wide percentiles of the peaks
